applies_to: Schneider Electric Altivar Process ATV630, ATV650, ATV660 and ATV690 drives on BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The Altivar Process ATV600 drives talk BACnet MS/TP as a B-ASC with a fixed object list. It covers relay and logic input status, run/stop, direction and fault reset commands, a speed reference, motor measurements, the last three faults, two analog outputs, eight read and eight write comm-scanner values, and a mailbox (MBOX) for reading or writing any drive parameter.
notes: Access is as printed: R read-only, W writable, C commandable.
Gaps in the instance numbering are not used; only the listed objects exist.
AI 16 and AI 17 report the analog output values even though they are Analog Input objects.
BO 0-2 only drive a relay when that relay has no other function assigned in the drive.
COM SCAN OUT1-8 and IN1-8 carry whatever drive registers are mapped in the comm scanner.
Names kept as printed, including 'KWH(R'. The doc gives both BI 8 and BI 9 the LI3 text and BV 23 only 'HELP'.

source.title: BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement, Altivar Process ATV630/ATV650/ATV660/ATV690

integration.summary: Write BV 10 RUN/STOP CMD and AV 16 INPUT REF 1 (%), and read BV 0, BV 2, BV 4 and AV 1/AV 4/AV 6 for status, fault, hand/auto, frequency, current and power. BV 14 resets a fault on a rising edge; AV 18-20 hold the current and two previous faults. Any other drive parameter can be read or written through the MBOX objects.

minimum_points.name: HAND/AUTO ACT
minimum_points.why: Shows if the drive is in Hand

integration.remote_sensors: The BMS can write the process PID setpoint to AV 27 EXT PID STPT. The document lists no BMS-written PID feedback object; COM SCAN OUT1-8 can carry other values into mapped drive registers.
setup: BACnet MS/TP master; baud rate Auto, 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800.
Segmented requests and responses are supported (window size 3); COV subscriptions are supported.
Objects are static; none can be created or deleted.
gotchas: The PICS does not say which drive settings (command and reference channel) must point at the fieldbus for BV 10 and AV 16 to act; check the drive programming manual.
To read a parameter: write its logic address to AV 25 MBOX PARAM, set BV 15 MBOX READ, then read AV 26 MBOX DATA.
To write a parameter: write the address to AV 25, the value to AV 26, then set BV 16 MBOX WRITE.
BV 15 and BV 16 drop back to inactive after the command is sent and always read 0.
AV 6 POWER and the AV 7/AV 15 thermal states are in %, not kW or degrees.
